business_summary: Sino Prima Gas Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the exploration, development, production, transmission, pressurization, and sales of natural gas in China. The company also provides natural gas boosting, pipeline transportation, and related services. The company was formerly known as Shanghai Worth Garden Products Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Sino Prima Gas Technology Co., Ltd. in January 2021. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China.

The company also provides natural gas boosting, pipeline transportation, and related services. 이 회사는 이전에 Shanghai Worth Garden Products Co., Ltd.로 알려졌으며 2021년 1월에 Sino Prima Gas Technology Co., Ltd.로 이름을 변경했습니다. 이 회사는 2003년에 법인화되었으며 중화인민공화국 상하이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
